Modifications: src/birdwatcher/_vendor/nanodet.py adds this provenance header,
Ruff formatting, and replaces filename-based cv2.dnn.readNet loading with
cv2.dnn.readNetFromONNX on a read-only uint8 view of verified immutable model
bytes; numerical decoder behavior is unchanged. bird_detector.py
reimplements the demo's RGB letterbox geometry with clipping and ROI offsets.
No weights or example photographs are distributed here. The optional pinned model
is object_detection_nanodet_2022nov.onnx, 3800954 bytes, SHA256
4b82da9944b88577175ee23a459dce2e26e6e4be573def65b1055dc2d9720186.
The surrounding BirdWatcherPi application remains under its MIT license.
